**Comparability:** Both figures are Apple Inc. consolidated full-fiscal-year amounts drawn from the same filing, same entity, same accounting basis — directly comparable [DOC-1].

**Calculation:**

| Fiscal Year | R&D Expense | Revenue | R&D % of Revenue |
|---|---|---|---|
| FY2023 | $29,915M [DOC-1] | $383,285M [DOC-1] | 7.80% |
| FY2024 | $31,370M [DOC-1] | $391,035M [DOC-1] | 8.02% |

- FY2023: 29,915 ÷ 383,285 = 7.805%
- FY2024: 31,370 ÷ 391,035 = 8.022%
- Change: +0.217 percentage points

**Interpretation:** R&D intensity **increased**, because R&D expense grew ~4.9% ($29,915M → $31,370M) [DOC-1] while revenue grew only ~2.0% ($383,285M → $391,035M) [DOC-1] — R&D outpaced the top line.

ANSWER: Increased by approximately 0.22 percentage points (7.80% in FY2023 to 8.02% in FY2024)
